title: Bobwhite Quail Slide Whistle (4-part)
description: Two-note "bob-WHITE" style whistle: a fipple whistle with a sliding piston rod you push and pull to glide the pitch.
use: Birdwatching / hobby accessory and toy; use lawfully.
material: PETG/PLA 0.12-0.16 mm. Wrap the piston groove with a thin rubber band as a seal.
assembly: 1. Press the fipple plug into the mouth end (flat windway side toward the window).
2. Stretch one thin rubber band into the piston groove as a seal. Slide the piston in from the far end (slide-fit, 0.25 mm radial play).
3. Thread the rod through the end cap hole, then press the cap into the far end of the body.
4. Blow and slide the rod to change pitch; a quick push-pull makes the two-note call.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
